authority: This file summarizes architecture verified against this repo. Runtime schema: types/database.ts + migrations (regen types if tables missing). Product marketing: docs/PROJECT_SUMMARY_APP.md. Do not treat this JSON as a release checklist.

capture_and_sync: Offline capture with later sync (mobile direction; SQLite + outbox planned — not in Admin repo)
Faster lead workflow from scan to pipeline
prioritization_and_signals: Real-time lead prioritization / hot lead scoring

code_verified_in_this_repository.description: Non-exhaustive; verify app/api and supabase/migrations for your branch.
includes: Next.js 16 App Router Admin: platform (/admin), organizer (/app/organizer, /organizer), exhibitor (/exhibitor, /app/exhibitor)
Lead Intelligence: exhibitor leads list/detail; per-lead AI Brief from public.lead_briefings; import wizard publish sync into lead_briefings
Campaigns API: list/create and related routes restricted to exhibitor_admin + platform_admin in route handlers
Signal Library API: list/create in route handlers restricted to exhibitor_admin + platform_admin

Seat / app access: evaluateAppAccessGrant and related helpers in lib/server/event-user-access.ts

excludes: Lead Intel Scan (Expo) mobile app source
badge_templates table (no migration in this repo)
Any capability not backed by types/database.ts + migrations in this branch

platform_product_capabilities.description: Cross-client product intent; realization split across Admin web, mobile, Supabase, and integrations.

shared_system_dependencies.object_storage: Audio and large assets; patterns vary by feature
shared_system_dependencies.enrichment_providers: Apollo, PDL, ZoomInfo — where credentials configured

future_extended_capabilities.mobile_offline_first: SQLite local_leads, sync_outbox, sync engine — planned; see docs/old/DB_SCHEMA_LOCKED.json mobile_local_sqlite_planned
future_extended_capabilities.analytics_roi: May aggregate leads/campaigns/email_events; not implied as fully shipped without code review

mobile.name: Lead Intel Scan
mobile.repo: Expo app (separate repository; not vendored here)

current_state.capture_persistence: Online-dependent for writing leads to Supabase (typical)
current_state.backend: Same Supabase project as Admin — shared Postgres contract (not a separate backend)
current_state.api_patterns: Bearer token session via resolveApiSession; exhibitor_viewer lead list requires eventId query param on implemented routes

planned_offline_first.local_sqlite: Canonical on-device store for capture (e.g. local_leads)
planned_offline_first.sync_outbox: Queue mutations; retry/backoff; idempotent server handling where applicable
planned_offline_first.sync_engine: Drains outbox to Supabase; success = rows in public.leads
planned_offline_first.audio: Local-first; upload queued as secondary job after lead sync (non-blocking for capture success)

web_admin.name: Lead Retrieval Admin
primary_flows: Platform admin: /admin — tenants, events, licenses, global signals, integrations
Exhibitor: Lead Intelligence, import wizard, AI Brief (lead_briefings), briefing knowledge, campaigns/signals UIs (API role gates apply), team/invites

supabase.auth_model: Supabase Auth; app roles in public.users.role; per-event membership in event_users; invite_codes drive redeem flows
supabase.rls: Enforced for tenant-scoped tables; service role / admin client used in server-only paths per route implementation

schema.note: No Prisma. Contract is types/database.ts + supabase/migrations/*.sql. Regenerate Supabase types when DDL changes (invite_codes may be missing from checked-in types until regen).

api.authn: Session via Supabase SSR; optional Bearer token path skips middleware refresh — handlers validate
api.authz: Per-handler role checks + company/event scope + Postgres RLS for direct Supabase queries
api.middleware_guards: lib/supabase/middleware.ts — prefix-based role routing; dev x-dev-bypass only in development

data_flow.admin_to_supabase: Direct via @supabase/ssr server and browser clients
data_flow.mobile_to_supabase: Direct Supabase client from mobile app (same project); optional HTTP API routes for shaped payloads
data_flow.import_publish_to_lead_briefings: Approved import_batch_row_briefings + publish materialization → upsert lead_briefings for exhibitor AI Brief
data_flow.mobile_planned_offline: App → SQLite (local_leads) → sync_outbox → sync engine → Supabase → public.leads
data_flow.audio_planned: Recorded locally → optional upload queue → storage (after lead payload is safe)

sendgrid.role: Outbound email for campaigns where integrated

enrichment_apollo_pdl_zoominfo.role: Lead enrichment where company/workspace credentials exist

object_storage.role: Voice/audio and large assets (e.g. AWS SDK in repo for tooling/uploads)

streampoint_v1_spec.role: Event registration ingest: sync registrants/badge identifiers for scan-time resolution (1:1 event mapping in V1 spec)
streampoint_v1_spec.note: Confirm implementation in application code/migrations; spec is non-canonical

architecture_guardrails: Single seat/app grant path: evaluateAppAccessGrant — not users.license_id or licenses.seats_used
exhibitor_admin vs exhibitor_viewer: use lib/auth/role-scope.ts; viewers blocked from many write APIs
Campaigns and signals HTTP APIs (app/api/campaigns*, app/api/signals*): list/create handlers allow only platform_admin + exhibitor_admin today
Organizer URLs: platform_admin middleware redirects away to /admin
Do not ship dev-only x-dev-bypass behavior to production clients
